proofTest.method: OpenCV GrabCut with manually seeded foreground and per-frame backward optical-flow mask propagation. 960x540 analysis, 1920x1080 composition at source frame rate; no neural model.

proofTest.acceptance: FAILED; internal experiment only, do not place in production cut list
observedFailures: At the opening pose, feet remain joined to a patch of floor; arm gaps retain busy background.
As Manon rises and attacks, the selected region expands into crowd, lighting structures and stage floor.
Impact particles and the opponent entering the region contaminate the matte; occlusion is not semantically resolved.
The far-right lower meter/HUD becomes part of the foreground near the end.
The background fragments and silhouette change visibly across adjacent sampled frames. Hair and hands are not reliably isolated. No weapon is present, so weapon quality was not tested.

review.method: Decoded moving MP4, 48 chronological comparison frames at 12 fps over the complete four-second interval, plus selected larger comparison frames. This is sequence inspection, not a claimed real-time human playback review.
review.conclusionLimit: Failure applies to this lightweight baseline/source. It does not establish that modern video matting with tracked masks and manual cleanup is impossible.
